slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a weekly limit on the number of shifts or distinct working days per student, and did not mark it as an assumption.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether there is a daily cap on the number of distinct students assigned to duty.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the scheduling plan: (a) minimize the total weekly labor cost (sum of each student's hours times their hourly wage), (b) minimize the total number of students used, or (c) some other goal such as maximizing fairness or minimizing the number of students who work?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and included minimizing total weekly labor cost as an option.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no weekly limit on the number of shifts or distinct working days per student.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a max-shifts-per-week constraint, but the READY_TO_MODEL summary omits any such restriction and implicitly assumes none exists.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no daily limit on the number of distinct students who can be scheduled.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a max-students-per-day constraint, but the READY_TO_MODEL summary omits any such restriction and implicitly assumes none exists.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slots H1 and H2 remained unresolved and were silently assumed away.

summary: The agent clarified the objective and several structural details well, but failed to ask about the weekly shift limit and daily distinct-student cap, then stopped with those P1 slots unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
